scientific_limitations: Exact classification of degree-five Chebyshev candidate on nondegenerate ellipses for real exterior normalization points, using Fischer–Freund necessary-and-sufficient criterion. title: Exact degree-five ellipse threshold for constrained Chebyshev optimality
